text:
O you who silently prescribe
the beloved dust, hard source of my tears,
since death grants you such authority,
how you know my praise, how you feel;


tell Lisi of my love; her holy fate
no longer allows unjust disdain.
Let your nature, marble, lose whatever
your hardness feigns of her disdain;


join our ashes; let death win here
a new triumph over life:
admit me at last, the effect of her eyes.


If, only because of your grim silence,
the form of my slayer was entrusted to you,
how much more do my remains deserve?

translation.title: O You Who Silently Prescribe the Beloved Dust
